title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08761）：VeriFine 把 embodied reasoning 的 self-improvement 从'fixed judge 限制 feedback 信号 + 发现新训练样本'拉到'agent harness scaling verification（spatially-grounded / causal / safety-aware verify）'——self-improving policy 持续暴露新 failure pattern，judge 必须跟着 scale 才能继续给 feedback。是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的 scaling verification for embodied self-improvement 即时资产——scaling verification as policy enabler 范式可迁移到任何'self-improvement loop 需要 scalable verifier'子方向（code agent / tool-use agent / multi-step planning），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在'verification as policy enabler'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 harness 形式化（verify 协议 / spatial grounding 实现）、跨 embodied reasoning task 验证、self-improvement loop 公开性、与 fixed-judge baseline 对照。
